items.name: Neodymium disc magnets, 6 × 2 mm
items.note: The box uses 4 (one pair per drawer); the pack leaves spares for the coupon and for a dropped magnet. The pull figures are for N52; weaker grades hold the drawers less firmly.

items.name: Baltic birch plywood, 1/8 in, 12 × 24 in, box of 12
items.spec: Woodpeckers, B/BB grade; true size 11-7/8 × 23-7/8 in (301.6 × 606.4 mm)
items.note: The 12 × 24 in layout uses {SHEETS_12x24} of these sheets per box, so a box of 12 covers two boxes with spares for the coupon. Measure the thickness before you pick a cut file.

items.name: Baltic birch plywood, 1/8 in, 5 × 5 ft sheet
items.note: Much cheaper per box if you can collect it: Toledo Plywood says its trucks deliver within 80 miles of Toledo, Ohio. In New York, lumber yards and plywood suppliers that stock Baltic birch will often cut a sheet down to fit a laser bed for a small fee; call ahead and ask for 1/8 in (3 mm) Baltic birch.

items.name: Wood glue
items.spec: Titebond III Ultimate Wood Glue, 8 oz
items.note: About 10 minutes of working time, so glue the box in short sessions. Use it sparingly, on the finger joints only.

items.name: CA glue, gel
items.spec: Loctite Super Glue Ultra Gel Control, 0.14 fl oz
items.note: A drop holds a magnet in its hole if the press fit is loose.

items.name: Sandpaper
items.note: You need 150 grit for scorched edges and 220 for a final pass. Any 150 and 220 sheets will do.

items.name: Paraffin wax
items.note: Rub it on the drawer sides and the lid edges so they glide. A plain candle stub works too.

items.name: Clear finish, water-based
items.note: Optional. One or two thin coats on the outside only, after assembly. Keep it off the sliding faces and the inside of the drawer bay. Water clean-up, low odor.

items.name: Digital calipers
items.note: To measure the plywood before you pick a cut file, and to check the coupon.

items.name: Painter's tape
items.note: Holds the joints closed while the glue sets; clamps are optional.

items.name: Paper trimmer
items.note: Optional. Cuts letter paper into quarter sheets (4.25 × 5.5 in) quickly. Scissors and a ruler also work.

items.name: Letter paper
items.spec: Hammermill Fore Multipurpose 20 lb, 8.5 × 11 in, 500 sheets
items.note: Cut each sheet into four quarter sheets (4.25 × 5.5 in): 500 sheets make 2,000 pages.
